title: Nothing you can see: Taylor's Pullman photograph re-aimed from across 18th Street
items: Nothing in the town changes. Taylor's photograph of Pullman's palm house is now matched from the spot it was taken, about 21 m south of the lot line across 18th Street, with the 18th Street wall in the fit. The comparison used to put the camera 10 m from the wall, which drew the wall twice as near as the photograph shows it.

Through the corrected camera the wall's foot and pier tops sit within a few pixels of the photograph. That shows what the old camera hid: east of the palm house the photograph has a way into the court about 4 m wide, where the build has a 0.95 m opening. The stable also reads about 0.8 m lower in the photograph than in the build. Both stay open in the match records, because the 1894 plate agrees with the build.
